schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
schemes.description: Financial assistance for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-secondary education with family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Direct income support to landholding farmer families across India holding cultivable land.

schemes.name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (KMUT)
schemes.description: Monthly rights grant for eligible women heads of households in Tamil Nadu.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.key_benefit: ₹5,00,000 cashless cover / family / year (+ universal 70+ senior top-up)
schemes.description: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization, including expanded universal top-up for all citizens aged 70+.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
schemes.key_benefit: Free LPG connection + 1st refill (14.2kg) + gas stove
schemes.description: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection along with free first refill and hotplate to adult women from BPL/poor households without an existing LPG connection.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca house to rural houseless families or households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses, with strict exclusion criteria.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description: Monthly central social assistance pension to senior citizens aged 60+ belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.key_benefit: Guaranteed ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 / month pension from age 60
schemes.description: Government-backed contributory pension scheme for unorganized sector workers aged 18-40; strictly excludes income tax payers since October 1, 2022.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.key_benefit: 8.2% p.a. sovereign guaranteed interest + tax exemption (Section 80C)
schemes.description: Small deposit savings scheme for girl children below 10 years of age, operated by parents/legal guardians with maximum 2 accounts per family.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
schemes.key_benefit: ₹12,000 / year (₹1,000 / month from Class IX to XII)
schemes.description: Merit scholarships for meritorious students of economically weaker sections (income <= ₹3.5L, Class VII marks >= 55%) studying in government/aided schools.

schemes.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
schemes.key_benefit: ₹1,000 / month DBT until completion of degree/diploma
schemes.description: Financial assistance for girl students who studied classes 6 to 12 continuously in Tamil Nadu government schools enrolling in recognized higher education courses.

schemes.name: Andhra Pradesh YSR Cheyutha Social Assistance Scheme
schemes.description: Financial empowerment assistance for SC, ST, BC, and Minority women aged 45 to 60 in Andhra Pradesh with exclusions for government employees and 4-wheeler vehicle owners.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma Scheme
schemes.description: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspersons across 18 trades, providing PM Vishwakarma certification, skill stipend, toolkit incentive, and subsidized loans.
